commands.name: claude_approve
commands.description: Loopback service-token command. Target: execution; risk: low.

request_id.description: ID of the pending approval request emitted via WS.

decision.description:
`allow` proceeds once; `allow_always` proceeds and persists a standing
permission for this tool/rule for the session; `deny` rejects with the
optional `message` shown to the model. To edit-and-allow, send
`decision: allow` together with `updated_input` (the substituted tool
arguments) — there is no separate `edit` decision value.

message.description: Optional rejection reason or note (denial only).

updated_input.description: Replacement tool input — substituted for the original arguments when sent (typically with `decision: allow`).

session_id.description: Logical session id chosen by the caller (Dexie row key).

prompt.description:
Either a plain string or an array of content blocks (text + image) — forwarded
verbatim to the Claude Agent SDK. Image blocks follow Anthropic's content-block format.

options.description:
Per-call options forwarded verbatim to the Claude Agent SDK (or the
AI SDK dispatch path for non-Anthropic providers). Unrecognised
fields ride along under `extra` (serde flatten). `null` is rejected
for optional fields — use `undefined`/missing instead, otherwise the
SDK's option parser crashes with "Cannot read properties of null".

systemPrompt.description: Replaces the SDK default system prompt. Mutually exclusive with appendSystemPrompt.

appendSystemPrompt.description: Appended to the SDK default. Mutually exclusive with systemPrompt.

mcpServers.description: Per-name MCP server config map; forwarded to the SDK verbatim.

agents.description: Dynamic subagent definitions keyed by name.

strictMcpConfig.description: When true, only `mcpServers` from this object are loaded — settings.json is ignored.

resumeSessionId.description: Resume an existing SDK session by id. Mutually exclusive with forkFromSessionId.

forkFromSessionId.description: Fork a new branch from an existing SDK session id.

provider.description:
Provider id this turn dispatches against. `null`/missing or
`"anthropic"` keeps the Claude Agent SDK path; any other value
(`openai`, `google`, `mistral`, `cohere`, `openrouter`, custom)
flows through the AI SDK dispatcher.

protocol.description: AI SDK protocol family (required for custom provider ids).

aliasResolution.description: Renderer-side metadata; the sidecar ignores this.
